Subject: TASK-1270 completed live; BUG-1232 cause confirmed; next wave staged

TASK-1270 (the last GitLab check) is Completed with the evidence on the spec: labelled MR → gate failed → detailed_merge_status ci_must_pass → API merge 405; aida merge-hold clear → gate green → mergeable → merged (into a throwaway base, mirror main untouched then fast-forwarded to GitHub main adc8625cd). The 405 is what glab prints as "not enough privileges", so BUG-1232 has a confirmed cause (comment on it): the merge phase should wait on detailed_merge_status rather than trust glab text.

Wave followups-0918d: BUG-1224, BUG-1226, BUG-1227, BUG-1222 merged; BUG-1230 and TASK-1271 in flight. Next wave followups-0918e is tagged and queued for when the lock frees: drain-mode BUG-1233, TASK-1276, TASK-163, TASK-1278; drive-mode BUG-1229, SPIKE-82, STORY-1221 (their PRs will open held for your gate). TASK-1277 and STORY-1218 are guided, so those wait for a keyboard session with the operator.

Still at your gate: #1935 (testimonial, docs) and #1936 (TASK-1269 smoke docs).
